heartRateRecoveryDiagnostics.note: Missing recovery values mean no sufficiently close post-exercise HR sample was returned; do not infer zero recovery.

paceDiagnostics.note: Pace trace and privacy-safe route remain Google Health secondary data. Garmin FIT summary is authoritative.

route.privacy: absolute GPS coordinates removed and orientation rotated before publication

run.dataSourceNotice: Garmin summary/heart-rate series, Tempest weather, Google Health secondary pace/route and recovery. Avoid interpreting mixed-source drift as a Garmin measurement.
